cases.block:
[#REQ-001, item, role=requirement, title="Render dashboard"]
--
The system SHALL render a Mustache template for the dashboard.
--

[#REQ-002, item, role=requirement, title="Detect items"]
--
The system SHALL use regex to detect item declarations.
--

[#REQ-003, item, role=requirement, title="Skip verbatim"]
--
The DocumentParser SHALL skip verbatim blocks.
--

[#REQ-004, item, role=requirement, title="Detect items"]
--
The system SHALL detect item declarations in AsciiDoc source files.
--

[#REQ-005, item, role=requirement, title="Neo4j export"]
--
The system SHALL export the traceability graph to Neo4j.
--

[#REQ-006, item, role=requirement, title="Parse and matrix"]
--
The system SHALL parse items and SHALL generate a matrix.
--
